I will avoid opening containers that are not the target destinations and will not collect items not listed in the goal.

My new strategy is: 1) Upon picking up an item, immediately attempt to place it using the special verb "acion" with the target syntax (e.g., `> acion comper on table` or `> acion arliced in atent`) instead of "put". 2) If "acion" fails for placement, try "arger" as the alternative placement verb. 3) Before moving to a new room, verify the item is still in my inventory; if I move away from an item's location without placing it, I must return to that specific room to re-acquire it before attempting placement again. 4) Execute the goal in a strict sequence: Pick up 'arliced' in 'tuat' -> Go to 'pantry' -> Use `> acion arliced in atent` (after opening 'atent' with `> shness atent`) -> Go to 'living room' -> Use `> acion comper on table` -> Use `> acion comess on distral` -> Type `> done`.
